prompt: A high-resolution MS gives M⁺ = 180.0423. Which molecular formula fits best?
explanation: High-resolution MS distinguishes formulas with the same nominal mass by their exact mass (via mass defects of C, H, N, O). C₉H₈O₄ = 180.0423 (aspirin's formula) vs C₆H₁₂O₆ = 180.0634 (glucose) — HRMS can tell them apart to 0.001 amu.
